topic: Comparing beta and production analytics data
summary_markdown: The conversation addressed the possibility of running campaigns across multiple cities and the discrepancy in frequency data between beta and production environments. When questioned about why the frequency differs, it was confirmed that the datasets for both beta and production are generally similar. To assist with starting the analysis, links were provided comparing the traffic dashboards for both beta and production environments using the same date range (Feb 7 - Feb 13).
decisions: Provided comparative dashboard links for beta and production analytics.
action_items: A meeting link was shared to discuss the topic further.
